kurzbeschreibung: The Galitzenklamm near Lienz impresses as a water adventure trail with roaring waterfalls, via ferratas, a water play park, and a historic mill.
beschreibung:
Family and Climbing Paradise at the Foot of the Lienzer Dolomiten

At the gateway to the Drautal near Lienz lies the Galitzenklamm, an oasis of water, stone, and pristine nature. The secure water theme path leads along boardwalks and wooden footbridges right up to the roaring cascades of the Galitzenbach.

History, Climbing, and Children's Adventures

Alongside the nature trail, informative panels and a historic watermill explain early artisanal craftsmanship. Climbing enthusiasts will discover spectacular via ferratas in the steep rock walls, while children explore the spacious water playground.
